This Petition, Coming On For Order

S, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE M.G. UMA  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE M.G. UMA) Petitioner being accused No.4 in Crime No.45/2025 of Kalaburagi City CEN Crime Police Station, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 120B, 406, 409, 420, 417 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, [for short 'IPC']
, pending on the file of the learned I Additional Civil Judge (Jr.Dn.) and J.M.F.C., Kalaburagi, is seeking for grant of anticipatory bail on the apprehension of being arrested.

2. Heard Sri Basavaling Nasi, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Gopalkrishna B. Yadav,
learned High NC: 2025:KHC-K:5154 HC-KAR Court Government Pleader for the respondent-State.
Perused the materials on record.
3.

In view of the rival contentions urged by the learned counsels for both the parties, the point that would arise for my consideration is:
"Whether the petitioner is entitled for grant of anticipatory bail under Section 482 of BNSS, 2023?"

My answer to the above point is in the 'Negative' for the following:
REASONS 4.

The informant filed the first information against accused Nos.1 to 4 alleging that, he was induced by accused Nos.1 to 4 to invest his money promising to give 15% returns per month and managed to get more than Rs.2,00,00,000/- from him.

Out of which, a small portion was returned, but still about Rs.2,00,00,000/- is due and the accused are evading, thereby, they have committed NC:
2025:KHC-K:5154 HC-KAR criminal conspiracy, criminal breach of trust and cheating.

Hence, he Abdul Khadar Basha vs State Through on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158619254/
2 requested the Police to register a case and initiate legal action.

sentences.text: 5. It is stated that, the informant invested the amount from 15.01.2022 to 15.10.2023 and the first information came to be lodged on 24.10.2024.
Till date, none of the accused have appeared before the Investigating Officer.
Looking to the nature and seriousness of the offence, I am of the opinion that the petitioner is not entitled for grant of anticipatory bail.

6. In view of the above, I answer the above point in the 'Negative' and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER The Criminal Petition is Dismissed.
Sd/-
